instructions.example: Example: Goal "Improve my leadership" → Reality "I struggle with quick decisions" → Options "Take a course, find a mentor" → Will "Dedicate 2 hours weekly starting Monday"
instructions.helpsCoachContext: — helps the coach use the right context and perspective

instructions.withoutProfile: Without a complete profile, your AI coach will not be fully personalized. Take 1 minute to complete it before your first session.
instructions.coachingStylesExplained: Coaching Styles — Choose the Right One for You
instructions.supportiveDesc: The coach provides warmth, validation, and positive reinforcement. Ideal if you need encouragement and emotional support while working toward your goals. The coach celebrates small wins and helps you stay motivated during setbacks.
instructions.supportiveBestFor: Best for: people new to coaching, going through difficult transitions, or who need confidence building.
instructions.directiveDesc: The coach gives clear recommendations, sets deadlines, and challenges you to take action immediately. Less discussion, more execution. Ideal if you prefer concrete advice, fast results, and dislike lengthy reflection.
instructions.directiveBestFor: Best for: goal-oriented professionals, people who want clear next steps, or those who tend to overthink.
instructions.socraticDesc: The coach rarely tells you what to do — instead, it asks powerful questions that guide you to find your own answers. This builds self-awareness and critical thinking. Coaching feels like guided exploration.
instructions.socraticBestFor: Best for: people who want to develop judgment and autonomy, reflective thinkers, or long-term personal development.
instructions.collaborativeDesc: The coach works as a thinking partner, co-creating solutions with you. It contributes ideas while also inviting yours, and the dynamic feels like a peer conversation. Good balance between guidance and autonomy.
instructions.shareContext: — the more context you share, the better
instructions.multipleSessions: You can create multiple sessions per goal to explore different angles
instructions.tipMoreSessions: Tip: The more sessions you have for a goal, the deeper the coaching becomes
instructions.completeProfileRequired2: Complete your Coaching Profile in Settings (required)
instructions.openChatLinkGoal: Open Chat, link the goal, and start your session
instructions.recommendedStartHere: Recommended: Start here BEFORE your first chat session
instructions.goToGoalsTab: Go to the Goals tab and create a goal using the GROW framework:
instructions.goalQuestion: What do you want to achieve? Be specific and measurable.
instructions.realityQuestion: Where are you now? What is the current situation?
instructions.optionsQuestion: What are possible approaches to reach your goal?
instructions.willQuestion: What is your commitment? What action will you take first?
instructions.goToChatTab: Go to the Chat tab and click "+ New Session"
instructions.selectGoalDropdown: Select a goal from the dropdown — the coach will have full GROW context
instructions.withoutGoalSelected: Without a goal selected, the coach still works but with less personalization
instructions.coachGuideGrow: The coach will guide you through GROW stages based on your goal
instructions.beHonestDetailed: Be honest and detailed — the more context you share, the better
instructions.section1Text: GrowAgentAI ("we", "us", "our", or "Company") operates the platform. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you use our Service.
instructions.section2Intro: We collect several different types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our Service to you:
instructions.personalData: Personal Data: Name, email address, password
instructions.usageData: Usage Data: Interactions with the platform, chat history, goals
instructions.deviceData: Device Data: Browser type, IP address, pages visited
instructions.section3Intro: GrowAgentAI uses the collected data for various purposes:
instructions.usePoint1: To provide and maintain our Service
instructions.usePoint2: To notify you about changes to our Service
instructions.usePoint3: To allow you to participate in interactive features
instructions.usePoint5: To gather analysis or valuable information
instructions.section4Text: The security of your data is important to us but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
instructions.section5Text: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date at the bottom of this Privacy Policy.
instructions.section6Text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@growagentai.com
